items.why: CoreWeave's bond sell-off revived fears about AI infrastructure spending, and AMD took a bigger hit than peers, per Barron's. Reports of slowing Anthropic revenue growth added pressure.
Caught in the same AI rout as chipmakers were hammered: TSMC struck a cautious 2027 note and hot September PPI data at 6.3% year over year stoked rate-hike fears.
Hotter-than-expected September PPI revived rate-hike bets, punishing high-beta names. Traders are also waiting on Thursday's Roadster event and Q3 results on Oct 21.
Gold caught a safe-haven bid as the AI rout drove investors toward bonds and defensive assets, per Bloomberg's markets wrap.

market_note: Nasdaq futures down about 1% while Dow futures clung to small gains.
summary: An AI-led chip rout deepened on Thursday as hot September PPI (6.3% year over year) revived rate-hike worries and AI infrastructure debt fears spread from CoreWeave to the chip names. Gold and Dow futures held up as money rotated to safety.
